situations.title: SBAR 기본 구조 인계
situations.tagline: Let me give you a quick SBAR on this patient.
situations.brief: 상황·배경·평가·권고 순서로 한 환자를 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: room four with chest pain since noon.
Background: history of high blood pressure, no cardiac history.
My recommendation is to keep him on the monitor.

situations.title: 교대 시 환자 요약
situations.tagline: Here's the quick rundown before you take over.
situations.brief: 활력징후·주호소·대기 검사를 중심으로 교대 환자를 요약 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Her vitals are stable, last set thirty minutes ago.
Chief complaint is abdominal pain since this morning.
We're still waiting on the CT results.

situations.title: 미결 업무 인계
situations.tagline: A few things still need to be done this shift.
situations.brief: 투약·검사·관찰 등 미결 업무를 명확히 정리해 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: His next antibiotic dose is due at four.
The urine sample still needs to go to the lab.
Please recheck her blood pressure in an hour.

situations.title: 환자 정보 재확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the name and diagnosis together.
situations.brief: 인수자와 함께 환자 이름·진단을 재확인하며 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is Mr. Alvarez in bed two, correct?
Working diagnosis is dehydration, ruling out infection.
Can you read the name band back to me?

situations.title: 우선순위 환자 지목
situations.tagline: This is the one I'd keep the closest eye on.
situations.brief: 여러 환자 중 주의 요망 환자를 지목하며 우선순위를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Watch bed three most closely this shift.
Her pressure has been trending down all afternoon.
If anything changes, call the doctor early.

situations.title: 병동 입원 인계
situations.tagline: Handing off to the floor — here's the key picture.
situations.brief: ER에서 병동으로 입원하는 환자의 핵심 정보를 압축해 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She's admitted for pneumonia, on IV antibiotics.
Last vitals were stable, oxygen at two liters.
Pending labs are her morning cultures.
goals: 병동에서 이어질 후속 계획을 명확히 한다

situations.title: 검사 대기 환자 인계
situations.tagline: He's still waiting on a couple of results.
situations.brief: 미결 검사 결과와 후속 조치가 있는 환자를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: His troponin is pending, due back within the hour.
If it's elevated, the doctor wants to be called.
The X-ray is done but not yet read.
goals: 대기 중인 검사와 예상 시점을 전달한다
결과에 따른 후속 조치를 명확히 한다

situations.title: 불안정 환자 교대 인계
situations.tagline: She could turn quickly — here's the plan if she does.
situations.brief: 악화 가능성이 있는 불안정 환자와 대응 계획을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Her pressure is borderline and trending down.
If systolic drops below ninety, start the fluid bolus.
The doctor is aware and wants a call for any change.
goals: 악화 시 즉각 대응 계획을 공유한다

situations.title: 다중 환자 동시 인계
situations.tagline: I've got four for you — let's prioritize.
situations.brief: 여러 환자를 동시에 인계하며 우선순위를 정리해 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start with the sickest and work down.
Bed one is stable and just waiting for discharge.
Bed three is the one that needs the most attention.
goals: 여러 환자를 우선순위 순으로 정리해 전달한다

situations.title: 인계 정보 누락 확인
situations.tagline: Wait — was anything ordered for her pain?
situations.brief: 인계 중 되묻기를 통해 정보 공백을 확인하고 보완하세요.
keyPhrases: You didn't mention her allergies — any I should know?
Was the pain medicine actually given, or just ordered?
Let me confirm the last vitals time before you go.

situations.title: 언어·문화 배경 전달
situations.tagline: There are a few communication needs to pass along.
situations.brief: 환자의 언어·문화적 특이사항과 통역 필요성을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: He speaks Vietnamese and needs a phone interpreter.
The family prefers a female nurse for personal care.
Please always confirm understanding through the interpreter.

situations.title: 정신과 보류 환자 인계
situations.tagline: He's on a psychiatric hold — here's the legal status.
situations.brief: 법적 상태와 감시 요구가 있는 정신과 보류 환자를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: He's under a seventy-two-hour hold, cannot leave.
He requires one-to-one observation at all times.
All sharps and cords have been removed from the room.
goals: 법적 상태와 감시 수준을 명확히 전달한다

situations.title: 가족 소통 이력 인계
situations.tagline: The family's been told part of the picture — here's where things stand.
situations.brief: 나쁜 소식 전달 여부 등 가족 소통 이력과 미해결 사항을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: The daughter knows the diagnosis but not the prognosis.
The doctor still needs to speak with the wife.
The son had a lot of anger earlier — be gentle.
goals: 가족에게 전달된 내용과 미해결 사항을 공유한다

situations.title: 기관 간 이송 인계
situations.tagline: I'm calling report for a transfer to your facility.
situations.brief: 타 병원으로 전원하는 환자를 전원 SBAR와 서류로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a transfer for a higher level of stroke care.
Symptom onset was two hours ago, tPA not given.
All records and imaging are traveling with the patient.

situations.title: 위중 환자 병동 전동
situations.tagline: She's crashing — we need to move her up now.
situations.brief: 급속 악화로 상급 병동으로 전동하는 위중 환자를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Her pressure keeps dropping despite fluids.
She's on a norepinephrine drip, titrating up.
She needs an ICU bed and close monitoring right now.
goals: 급속 악화 경과와 현재 지지 요법을 전달한다

situations.title: 코드 후 ICU 인계
situations.tagline: This is the post-arrest patient — here's where we are.
situations.brief: 심정지 소생 경과와 현재 상태를 ICU 간호사에게 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: this is a fifty-eight-year-old post-cardiac-arrest patient.
Background: down time was about eight minutes with two shocks.
Right now he's on a norepinephrine drip and intubated.
goals: 소생 경과·투약·현 상태를 SBAR 순서로 전달한다

situations.title: 교대 중 급변 발생
situations.tagline: He just changed — let's re-do this handoff fast.
situations.brief: 인계 도중 환자가 급변한 상황에서 인계 내용을 재조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Forget what I just said — his status has changed.
His oxygen just dropped to eighty-five percent.
Let's both go see him and reassess together.
goals: 급변에 맞춰 인계 정보를 즉시 갱신한다

situations.title: 불완전 정보 이송 수용
situations.tagline: The report we got is thin — let's fill the gaps.
situations.brief: 외부에서 온 불완전한 인계 정보를 보완하며 이송 환자를 수용하세요.
keyPhrases: We didn't get her medication list — do you have it?
Can you confirm when the last dose was given?
I'll reassess from scratch to be safe.

situations.title: 다직역 인계 회의
situations.tagline: Let's get everyone on the same page for this patient.
situations.brief: 의사·간호·사회복지가 함께하는 다직역 인계 회의에서 역할을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: From nursing, her pain is controlled but mobility is poor.
Social work is arranging safe discharge to a shelter.
Let's agree who follows up on each item.

situations.title: 대량재해 환자 분류 인계
situations.tagline: Here are the triage tags — reds first.
situations.brief: 대량재해 상황에서 트리아지 분류 결과를 팀에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: We have three reds, five yellows, and eight greens.
The reds are in bays one through three, most critical first.
Reassess yellows every fifteen minutes for changes.
